segments.sn56.39:1.1: “Ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā ‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti … pe …
segments.sn56.39:1.2: ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti, te aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukhaṃ ullokenti [olokenti (sī. syā.)]–
segments.sn56.39:1.3: ‘ayaṃ nūna bhavaṃ jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passatī’”ti.
segments.sn56.39:2.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, tūlapicu vā kappāsapicu vā lahuko vātūpādāno same bhūmibhāge nikkhitto.
segments.sn56.39:2.2: Tamenaṃ puratthimo vāto pacchimena saṃhareyya, pacchimo vāto puratthimena saṃhareyya, uttaro vāto dakkhiṇena saṃhareyya, dakkhiṇo vāto uttarena saṃhareyya.
segments.sn56.39:2.5: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā ‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti … pe …
segments.sn56.39:2.6: ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti, te aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukhaṃ ullokenti –
segments.sn56.39:2.7: ‘ayaṃ nūna bhavaṃ jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passatī’ti.
segments.sn56.39:3.1: “Ye ca kho keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā ‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti … pe …
segments.sn56.39:3.2: ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti, te na aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukhaṃ ullokenti –
segments.sn56.39:3.3: ‘ayaṃ nūna bhavaṃ jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passatī’”ti.
segments.sn56.39:4.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ayokhīlo vā indakhīlo vā gambhīranemo sunikhāto acalo asampakampī.
segments.sn56.39:4.2: Puratthimāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi, neva saṅkampeyya [neva naṃ saṅkampeyya (sī. pī.)] na sampakampeyya na sampacāleyya; pacchimāya cepi disāya … pe … uttarāya cepi disāya … pe … dakkhiṇāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi, neva saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampacāleyya.
segments.sn56.39:4.5: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, ye ca kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā ‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti … pe …
segments.sn56.39:4.6: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti, te na aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukhaṃ ullokenti –
segments.sn56.39:4.7: ‘ayaṃ nūna bhavaṃ jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passatī’ti.
segments.sn56.39:4.11: Dukkhassa ariyasaccassa … pe … dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasaccassa.
segments.sn56.39:5.1: “Tasmātiha, bhikkhave,‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yogo karaṇīyo … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yogo karaṇīyo”ti.

lines: So hi “idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan”ti gāhassa mukhabhūtattā mukhanti adhippeto.
Tañca apare adiṭṭhasaccā olokenti, diṭṭhasaccā pana neva olokenti.
